Stats

Vampire_Spawn
Andrik is an Undead Vampire Spawn who is imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon. He is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by  Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn.

Interactions

Andrik is in a prison containing Vampire spawn children in Cazador's Dungeon. Like  Chessa, Andrik can either be consumed or set free depending on the choices made after slaying  Cazador.
